newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates end mixed.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates end mixed.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed mixed on Tuesday amid increased demand from spinners.
Dealers said rising supply is likely to keep prices steady.
They said demand rose as spinners, who are unsure of the extent of crop damage from pests in the central Punjab province, built up forward cover.
But officials say the damage is not alarming and the output target of 10 million 375-lb bales set for fiscal 1996/97 (July-June) will be achieved.
In the kerb market dealers said NIAB-78 variety was traded in the range of 2,150 rupees ($58.01) and 2,125 rupees per maund (37.32 kg).
